description: This file contains test routines for checking protocol disabling in Git, including functions for testing clone, fetch, push operations under different protocol allow configurations and environment variables.

methods.name: test_allow_var
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, push with environment variable GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL under enabled and disabled settings.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, push with protocol.<type>.allow config options and environment variable GIT_PROTOCOL_FROM_USER.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Runs both allow_var and config tests for a specific protocol, given its description, name, and URL.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up an SSH wrapper script to facilitate SSH-based Git operations for testing.

methods.name: setup_ext_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up a wrapper script for remote-ext testing, simulating remote repository access.
